item_source.name: item_source
item_source.value: "commande_items"."article_id" IS NOT NULL OR "commande_items"."combo_id" IS NOT NULL

annulation_tracee.name: annulation_tracee
annulation_tracee.value: "commande_items"."statut_cuisine" <> 'ANNULE' OR ("commande_items"."annule_par" IS NOT NULL AND "commande_items"."annule_motif" IS NOT NULL)

remise_motif_obligatoire.name: remise_motif_obligatoire
remise_motif_obligatoire.value: "commandes"."remise_montant" = 0 OR ("commandes"."remise_motif" IS NOT NULL AND "commandes"."remise_par" IS NOT NULL)
